rows.source:
import codecs
info = codecs.lookup('big5')
print(info.name)
decoder = info.incrementaldecoder()
print(repr(decoder.decode(b'\xa4')), decoder.getstate())
print(repr(decoder.decode(b'\xa4', True)), decoder.getstate())
def recover(error):
    print(type(error).__name__, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    assert input() == 'continue'
    return ('?', -1)
codecs.register_error('big5-service', recover)
print(info.decode(b'\xffA', 'big5-service'))
print(info.encode('\ud800A', 'big5-service'))
